fact: The Bank of Uganda notice says its RTGS and ACH services, part of the national payments infrastructure, are in service until a scheduled closure from 5 to 9 November 2026 for an upgrade.
We Are Tech Africa reports NALA secured Payment Service Provider and Payment System Operator licences from the Bank of Uganda.
Daily Monitor reports the Bank of Uganda approved at least 17 payment licences in the year, for e-money issuers, payment service providers and aggregators.

Bank of Uganda's public notice says it has licensed 54 payment system operators, payment service providers and issuers of payment instruments since March 2021 under the National Payment Systems Act, Cap 59.
